successCriteria.description: `npm run build` completes cleanly with no TypeScript errors or unused-import diagnostics.
All existing tests pass unchanged (no test file is modified by this phase).
`src/modules/leave/leave.service.ts` contains no import from `../leave-type` (the `import { PgLeaveTypeRepository, LeaveTypeService } from '../leave-type';` line is removed).

`createLeaveService()` constructs its policy-service collaborator via `createPolicyService()` and no longer contains the inline `new PolicyService(new PgLeavePolicyRepository(), new LeaveTypeService(new PgLeaveTypeRepository()))` expression.

constraints: The `LeaveService` class, its constructor signature, and all runtime behaviour are unchanged — the edit is confined to the `createLeaveService()` factory and the import block.
`createPolicyService` must be imported from the policy module's public entry point (`../policy`), never from a deep file path.

`IPolicyService` must remain imported from `../policy` (it is still the type of the `policyService` constructor parameter); only `PolicyService` and `PgLeavePolicyRepository` are removed from that import block.
No other module or file is modified in this phase — the change is confined to `src/modules/leave/leave.service.ts`.
outOfScope: Any change to the `LeaveService` class body, its constructor signature, its public interface (`ILeaveService`), or its runtime behaviour.
Any change to the policy module, the leave-type module, or the balance module (Phase 1 and Phase 2 already delivered those).
Amending docs/ARCHITECTURE.md — the dependency map already reflects `leave -> policy` without `leave -> leave-type`, so no amendment is required.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The `createPolicyService` symbol imported by `leave.service.ts` must be the exact factory exported from the policy public entry point, which constructs `new PolicyService(new PgLeavePolicyRepository(), new LeaveTypeService(new PgLeaveTypeRepository()))` — so the leave factory's policy collaborator is behaviourally identical to the inline construction it replaces.
The resulting dependency edges must match the reconciled architecture's dependency map: `leave -> policy` present, `leave -> leave-type` absent, `policy -> leave-type` retained.

integrationPoints.why: The leave convenience factory delegates PolicyService construction to the policy module's owned composition factory, removing the leave -> leave-type edge.
